headline: mikelou1 climbs into ARC-3 gold at 17th

sections.text: mikelou1 climbed from 30th to 17th, gaining 1.85 points to reach 37.27 and move into the 18 public gold places.
The cutoff rose 0.11 in the past day to 37.18 at 18th. Md Boktiar Mahbub Murad is first outside gold, 19th at 37.12, just 0.06 short.
